title: Add a license
body:
An open source license adds protections for the author, contributors, and users.

I suggest a permissive license like MIT or Apache2 if you're optimizing for impact and not afraid of other projects reusing the code.

Can go in the GitHub UI, add new file, type `LICENSE` and it will give a bunch of templates, or I can send a PR.
author: shazow

title: Mobile posting doesn't work
body:
Two different issues that are simultaneously happening:
1. Get's stuck on awaiting signature after signing message in wallet
2. Generating proof takes really long or causes blank screen.

For the second issue, this is likely because the circuit is just requiring too much processing power from the mobile device.
